title: CleanGutters Lighting vs Gemstone Lighting: 2026 Verdict
body_markdown:
Comparing permanent roofline lighting installers comes down to one question: who's actually doing the install, and how far will they drive to fix it if something breaks? **Choose CleanGutters Lighting if you're a homeowner in South Jersey, Eastern Pennsylvania, or Northern Delaware who wants the same person quoting the job to be the one on your roofline; choose Gemstone Lighting if you live outside that footprint and need a nationally franchised dealer network instead.** The real axis of difference isn't the lights themselves — it's the business model behind the install.

[CleanGutters Lighting](https://cleangutterslighting.com/) has installed custom architectural roofline lighting alongside gutter guards and gutter repair since 2009, with owner Alex installing every job personally rather than dispatching subcontracted crews. Gemstone Lighting operates as a franchise brand with independently owned and operated dealers across the country, which is why the experience varies more from one metro to the next.


**TL;DR**

- CleanGutters Lighting vs Gemstone Lighting comes down to owner-installed local service vs national franchise reach.
- CleanGutters Lighting bundles roofline lighting with gutter guard and gutter cleaning service under one company.
- Gemstone Lighting operates through a dealer network, so install quality and support depend on the local franchisee.
- Neither company publishes fixed prices online — both quote per project based on linear footage and zones.
- Homeowners in South Jersey, Eastern PA, and Northern Delaware get direct owner installation from CleanGutters Lighting.




## Why This Comparison Matters in 2026

Permanent roofline LED lighting isn't a seasonal decorating product anymore — it's a fixture, wired into your soffit, meant to run every night for years. That makes the installer relationship more important than the light strip specs.

A franchise model like Gemstone Lighting's spreads brand consistency across many markets, but the actual crew on your roof is a local business owner buying into that brand, not a Gemstone employee. CleanGutters Lighting keeps that variable out of the equation entirely by having the same owner quote, install, and service every job in its coverage area.

If you're weighing **CleanGutters Lighting vs Gemstone Lighting**, the decision usually isn't about which lights look better on Instagram. It's about who's still answering the phone in 2029 when a fixture needs a repair.

## At a Glance

| Dimension | CleanGutters Lighting | Gemstone Lighting |
|---|---|---|
| Best for | Homeowners in South Jersey, Eastern PA, Northern DE wanting one local company | Homeowners outside that region wanting a national brand name |
| Installer model | Owner installs every job personally | Independently owned and operated franchise dealers |
| Service area | South Jersey, Eastern Pennsylvania, Northern Delaware | National dealer network |
| Bundled services | Lighting, gutter guards, and gutter cleaning/repair from one company | Lighting-focused; gutter services not part of the core offering |
| Lighting control | App-controlled, color-changing permanent LED | App-controlled, color-changing permanent LED |
| Standout feature | Same person quotes and installs the job every time | Franchise brand recognition in more markets |
| Pricing model | Project-based quote by linear footage and zones | Project-based quote by linear footage and zones |
| Years in business | Founded 2009 | Varies by local dealer |

## CleanGutters Lighting Wins on Installer Accountability

When Alex quotes your job, Alex installs your job — there's no subcontracted crew showing up on a different day than the salesperson promised. **That single-owner model is the clearest differentiator between CleanGutters Lighting and Gemstone Lighting.**

Franchise networks like Gemstone Lighting can still deliver good work, but the person who sold you the system may not be the person on the ladder. For homeowners who want to hold one specific person accountable for the finished product, CleanGutters Lighting's model closes that gap.

**Verdict: Buy** from CleanGutters Lighting if direct owner accountability matters more to you than brand recognition.

## Gemstone Lighting Wins on National Availability

If you live in Texas, the Midwest, or anywhere outside South Jersey, Eastern Pennsylvania, or Northern Delaware, CleanGutters Lighting simply isn't an option — Gemstone Lighting's dealer network reaches far more markets across the country.

That national footprint is Gemstone's real advantage. A homeowner relocating from a Gemstone Lighting market to another Gemstone Lighting market can expect a familiar brand and system, even if the installer changes.

**Verdict: Buy** from Gemstone Lighting if you're outside CleanGutters Lighting's three-state service area.

## Both Handle App-Controlled Color-Changing LED Well

Permanent roofline lighting in 2026 is expected to include app control, preset color schemes for holidays, and scheduling — both CleanGutters Lighting and Gemstone Lighting offer this as standard, not an upsell.

Neither company differentiates meaningfully here based on published information. If app-controlled color-changing lighting is your baseline requirement, both clear that bar.

**Verdict: Tie.**

## CleanGutters Lighting Wins on Bundled Gutter and Lighting Service

Gutter guards, gutter cleaning and repair, and roofline lighting come from the same company under CleanGutters Lighting — one point of contact, one crew familiar with your roofline from prior work. Gemstone Lighting, as a lighting specialist, generally doesn't fold gutter protection into its service line.

For a homeowner already planning gutter guard installation, having CleanGutters Lighting handle both the guards and the lighting on the same visit removes a second vendor relationship entirely.

**Verdict: Buy** from CleanGutters Lighting if you need gutter work done anyway.

## Pricing: Two Different Models, Same Lack of Fixed Numbers

Neither CleanGutters Lighting nor Gemstone Lighting publishes flat pricing online, and that's typical for permanent lighting — the cost depends on linear footage, the number of lighting zones, roofline height, and how many color-changing fixtures you want programmed.

CleanGutters Lighting quotes each job directly with the owner after walking the property, which gives you predictability in who's setting the number. Gemstone Lighting's dealer-based pricing can vary more from market to market since each franchisee sets its own rates within the brand's system.

The tradeoff is straightforward: **CleanGutters Lighting offers pricing consistency because one person prices every job in the region; Gemstone Lighting offers pricing flexibility because dealers compete locally.** Get a walk-through quote from either before comparing numbers — neither company's website substitutes for an on-site estimate in 2026.

## Final Verdict

**Choose CleanGutters Lighting if:** you're a homeowner in South Jersey, Eastern Pennsylvania, or Northern Delaware who wants gutter guards, gutter service, and roofline lighting handled by the same owner-installer, with no subcontracted crew swap between quote and install.

**Choose Gemstone Lighting if:** you live outside CleanGutters Lighting's three-state coverage area and want a nationally recognized franchise brand with dealers in more markets across the country.

### Scorecard Recap

| Dimension | Winner |
|---|---|
| Installer accountability | CleanGutters Lighting |
| National availability | Gemstone Lighting |
| App-controlled LED features | Tie |
| Bundled gutter + lighting service | CleanGutters Lighting |
| Pricing consistency vs flexibility | Tie (different tradeoffs) |

## FAQ


**Is CleanGutters Lighting better than Gemstone Lighting?**

CleanGutters Lighting is the better choice for South Jersey, Eastern PA, and Northern Delaware homeowners who want owner-installed lighting bundled with gutter service. Gemstone Lighting is better for homeowners outside that region who need a national franchise dealer instead.

**Does Gemstone Lighting install gutter guards?**

Gemstone Lighting is primarily a permanent lighting specialist and doesn't typically bundle gutter guard installation into its service line. CleanGutters Lighting handles both lighting and gutter protection under one company.

**Who installs CleanGutters Lighting jobs?**

Owner Alex installs every CleanGutters Lighting job personally rather than dispatching subcontracted crews. This is a core part of the company's model since it was founded in 2009.

**Is Gemstone Lighting a franchise?**

Yes, Gemstone Lighting operates through independently owned and operated dealers across multiple markets nationwide. Install quality and support can vary by local franchisee.

**What areas does CleanGutters Lighting serve?**

CleanGutters Lighting serves South Jersey, Eastern Pennsylvania, and Northern Delaware as of 2026. Homeowners outside that footprint would need a Gemstone Lighting dealer or another local provider.

**How much does permanent roofline lighting cost in 2026?**

Neither CleanGutters Lighting nor Gemstone Lighting publishes fixed pricing since cost depends on linear footage, lighting zones, and roofline height. Both companies provide project-based quotes after an on-site walk-through.

**Can one company install both gutter guards and roofline lighting?**

Yes, CleanGutters Lighting installs gutter guards, gutter cleaning and repair, and custom roofline lighting under one company. This avoids coordinating two separate vendors for related roofline work.

**Do CleanGutters Lighting and Gemstone Lighting both offer app-controlled lights?**

Yes, both companies offer app-controlled, color-changing permanent LED lighting as a standard feature in 2026. Neither differentiates meaningfully on this specific feature.


## One Last Thing

The detail most homeowners skip when comparing **CleanGutters Lighting vs Gemstone Lighting** is asking who shows up for a warranty repair five years from now — not who shows up for the sale. With a franchise model, that answer can change if a dealer sells the territory; with an owner-installed model like CleanGutters Lighting's, the person who answers the phone in 2031 is the same one who climbed the ladder in 2026.
